headline: Worker 755: Inside the LLM Subagent Terminal Game
summary: Discover Worker 755, a unique terminal game that flips the script by letting you experience software engineering from the perspective of an LLM subagent. Learn how command-line mechanics mimic autonomous agent execution flows.

slides.title: What if you were the AI's assistant?
slides.subtitle: Experience software engineering from the perspective of a constrained subagent.
slides.body: Modern developers orchestrate LLM agents daily, but rarely experience the terminal constraints and micro-tasks from the agent's point of view.
slides.deep_dive: Worker 755 turns this dynamic upside down by casting you as the subagent receiving tasks inside a retro terminal interface.
slides.key_fact: Simulates the exact lifecycle of an LLM micro-task executor.
slides.why_it_matters: Builds deep intuition for how autonomous coding agents parse and execute terminal commands.
